name: Should I manage my multifamily property myself or hire a property manager?

mainEntity.name: Should I manage my multifamily property myself or hire a property manager?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to self-manage or hire a property manager depends on your time availability, experience, and the property's size. Self-managing can save costs but requires handling tenant screening, maintenance requests, rent collection, and legal compliance. Hiring a professional property manager, especially for larger properties or if you live remotely, can streamline operations and ensure compliance with local landlord-tenant laws. This is a practical tradeoff: save money and gain control by self-managing, or save time and potentially increase efficiency by hiring a professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choosing between self-management and a property manager depends on your time and experience. Self-management saves costs but demands time; a manager streamlines operations for a fee.
